propositions: After Jira returns a create key, the known key must be persisted on the still-pending RP-02 entry before any label attachment to enable deterministic recovery if crash occurs in the create-to-label window.
Known key and binding confirmation must persist exclusively through the RP-02 BindingStore facade; no secondary binding writer is created.
Post-create failures (label, property, or persistence) must preserve the known key, recovery evidence, and remote issue without deletion.
The canonical rebar-id label must be attempted before optional property enrichment, and local confirmation (bind_confirm) must occur only after label success.
Property unsupported or permission failures are treated as visible enrichment failures that cannot erase a successful label or trigger rollback.
Lifecycle intents downstream must execute only after their remote postconditions are proven via binding confirmation.
